features.description: Create the project skeleton: setup.py with metadata and dependencies (html5lib, tinycss2, webencodings, pytest, etc.), bleach/__init__.py that exports clean, linkify, DEFAULT_CALLBACKS, html5lib_shim, and other core symbols. Stub out all required modules (sanitizer.py, linkifier.py, css_sanitizer.py, callbacks.py, parse_shim.py, html5lib_shim.py) with minimal placeholder classes/functions so that imports succeed.

acceptance.command: cd workspace && python -c "from bleach import clean, linkify, DEFAULT_CALLBACKS, html5lib_shim; from bleach.sanitizer import Cleaner, ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS; from bleach.linkifier import Linker, LinkifyFilter; from bleach.css_sanitizer import CSSSanitizer; from bleach.callbacks import nofollow, target_blank; print('All imports OK')"
acceptance.api_check: cd workspace && python -c "from bleach import clean, linkify; from bleach.sanitizer import Cleaner; from bleach.css_sanitizer import CSSSanitizer; from bleach.linkifier import Linker; from bleach.callbacks import nofollow"

features.notes: Project skeleton created. All imports pass, all modules stubbed.

features.description: Set up pytest testing framework: create tests/ directory with conftest.py if needed, ensure pytest discovers 0 tests initially. Write a trivial placeholder test to verify configuration.

acceptance.command: cd workspace && python -m pytest --version && python -m pytest tests/ -q

features.notes: Tests folder with placeholder, pytest discovers and runs tests.

features.description: Implement bleach.sanitizer.clean function with signature `clean(text, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS, strip=False, strip_comments=True, css_sanitizer=None)`. It must remove script tags, escape disallowed tags (unless strip=True replaces them with children), filter attributes, and handle protocols. Create test file tests/test_sanitizer.py with function test_clean_basic that verifies: script tag removal, allowing safe tags (p, b, i), escaping when tag not allowed, and strip=True behavior.
features.notes: clean() function working. Tests cover script removal, safe tags, escaping, strip, comments, attributes, protocols.

features.description: Extend clean to handle attribute filtering (whitelist per tag), protocol sanitization (e.g., drop javascript: hrefs), comment removal, and character entity preservation. Write test function test_clean_advanced in tests/test_sanitizer.py that covers: removing javascript: protocol from a href, stripping src from img if not allowed, removing HTML comments, preserving valid entities like &.
features.notes: Advanced tests pass: JS protocol removal, img src stripping, comment removal, entity preservation, mailto protocol.

features.description: Implement bleach.sanitizer.Cleaner class with __init__(tags, attributes, protocols, strip, strip_comments, filters, css_sanitizer) and .clean(text) method. Write test file tests/test_cleaner.py with test_cleaner function that creates a Cleaner with custom tags/attributes, cleans multiple texts, and verifies output.
features.notes: Cleaner class with custom tags, attributes, protocols, strip, strip_comments, filters works.

features.description: Implement bleach.linkifier.linkify function with signature `linkify(text, callbacks=DEFAULT_CALLBACKS, skip_tags=None, parse_email=False)`. It must detect URLs (using a configurable URL regex), wrap them in <a> tags with nofollow callback applied, and skip tags in skip_tags. Write test file tests/test_linkifier.py with function test_linkify_basic that covers: conversion of http://example.com to a link, nofollow attribute added, skipping content inside <pre> and <code> tags, and correct handling when no URL present.
features.notes: Fixed: __init__.py linkify() now defaults to DEFAULT_CALLBACKS (nofollow applied by default). Added standalone linkify() function to bleach/linkifier.py with correct signature. All tests pass.

features.description: Enhance linkify to handle email addresses (parse_email=True), parentheses, punctuation, and custom callbacks. Write test function test_linkify_advanced in tests/test_linkifier.py that verifies: email linking with mailto:, parenthetical wrapping like (http://example.com), trailing punctuation exclusion, and applying multiple callbacks (e.g., nofollow, target_blank, custom).
features.notes: Advanced features work: email mailto linking, parenthetical URLs, trailing punctuation exclusion, multiple callbacks (nofollow+target_blank).

features.description: Implement bleach.linkifier.Linker class with __init__(callbacks, skip_tags, parse_email, url_re, email_re, recognized_tags) and .linkify(text) method. Also provide build_url_re(tlds) helper to generate custom URL patterns. Write tests/test_linker.py with test_linker function that verifies Linker instantiation, custom TLDs, and batch processing.
features.notes: Linker class fully implemented and tested: __init__, linkify(), build_url_re(), custom TLDs, batch processing.

features.description: Implement bleach.css_sanitizer.CSSSanitizer class with __init__(allowed_css_properties, allowed_svg_properties) and .sanitize_css(style: str) -> str. Use tinycss2 to parse CSS and filter properties, values, and functions. Dangerous values like url(javascript:...) must be removed, safe color and font properties preserved. Write test file tests/test_css_sanitizer.py with test_css_sanitizer that verifies: removal of background: url('javascript:...'), preservation of color: red, handling of comments, and SVG property filtering.
features.notes: CSSSanitizer.sanitize_css() implemented: parses with tinycss2, filters by allowed properties, strips url()/expression()/FunctionBlocks. Comments and dangerous values removed.

features.description: Implement bleach.callbacks.nofollow and target_blank callbacks. nofollow adds rel='nofollow' (or appends 'nofollow' to existing rel). target_blank adds target='_blank'. Write tests/test_callbacks.py with test_callbacks function that directly tests these callbacks with input attrs dict and verifies correct modification.
features.notes: nofollow and target_blank callbacks implemented. nofollow appends to existing rel values without duplicating. All tests pass.

features.description: Integrate custom callbacks into linkify and Linker, supporting return None to drop links. Write test function test_custom_callbacks in tests/test_linkifier.py that defines a custom callback that adds title attribute, and another that blocks evil.com by returning None, and verifies combined effect.
features.notes: Custom callbacks integrated. Fixed: when callback returns None, URL text now preserved as plain text (not dropped). Tests cover title addition, evil.com blocking, and combined effects.

features.description: Implement bleach.html5lib_shim module with a Filter base class (inherited from html5lib.filters.base.Filter) and a convert_entities function that converts HTML entities using html5lib serializer. Write test file tests/test_html5lib_shim.py with test_convert_entities that verifies & to & etc.
features.notes: Import html5lib.filters.base.Filter to subclass. convert_entities should use html5lib.serializer.HTMLSerializer.

features.description: Implement bleach.linkifier.LinkifyFilter, an html5lib filter that applies linkification during tree traversal. Integrate it into Cleaner so that Cleaner(filters=[LinkifyFilter(callbacks=..., ...)]) can clean and linkify in one pass. Write test file tests/test_integration.py with test_linkify_filter that creates a Cleaner with a LinkifyFilter and processes HTML, verifying that links are created inside allowed elements.
features.notes: Should handle text nodes that contain URLs and wrap them in <a> while respecting existing links and skip_tags.

features.description: Implement combined usage of clean, CSSSanitizer, and linkify. Write test function test_combined in tests/test_integration.py that takes dirty HTML with scripts, styles, and URLs, runs clean with CSSSanitizer, then linkify with nofollow and parse_email, and verifies final output is safe and contains proper links.
features.notes: Simulate real-world scenario: script removal + style sanitization + linkification.

features.description: Implement bleach.parse_shim.urlparse as a wrapper around urllib.parse.urlparse that returns an object with attributes scheme, netloc, path, params, query, fragment. Write test file tests/test_parse_shim.py with test_urlparse that parses a URL and asserts each component.
features.notes: Should handle user:pass, port, fragment, etc. as per docs.
